summary: Frontend-only test of Payroll Reports view (§43) as owner@isodemo.com. Login -> /launch -> Operations -> Staffing -> Payroll tab renders successfully. Workspace|Reports toggle works. Clicking Reports renders payroll-reports with 6 KPI tiles, date range inputs defaulting to current month (2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-30), a recharts BarChart 'Hours by department' (SVG rendered), 3 submission tiles, and a by-employee table (10 rows with data-testid payroll-report-emp-<staff_id>) with colour-coded attendance %. Changing dates to a future/empty range re-fetches without crash. Toggling back to Workspace shows the period workspace (regression pass). No runtime errors; only a benign recharts container-size warning during first paint.

issues: Benign recharts warning 'width(-1) height(-1)' on initial mount when ResponsiveContainer parent has no width during transition; harmless but could be silenced by setting minWidth=0 on wrapper

critical_code_review_comments: PayrollReports uses inline date-range fetch on every keystroke via useEffect (from/to as deps). For rapid date typing this may trigger multiple in-flight requests; acceptable for now but consider debouncing.

Empty-range case: backend returns all employees with zeros, so the 'No data in this range' message only appears when by_employee is empty. This is acceptable but the UX message may be misleading when totals are all 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayrollReports fully verified in Sep 2026 timeframe against iso-demo-org. Tiles: Hours worked / Overtime / Holiday / Sick / Attendance rate / Adjustments; recharts BarChart with Worked+Overtime bars by department; submission tiles on_time/late/missing; employee table with attendance colour-coded (>=90 green, >=70 amber, else red).
